scenarios: backend contract suite on a real Firecracker MicroVM over KVM (hosted cloud job)
backend contract suite on the reference backend (every OS)
gateway tenant and lease binding over a real Postgres
proof: a real Firecracker MicroVM boots the real modbit-guest image and passes the backend contract over vsock (processes, policy-bound filesystem, no network interface, authenticated and replay-safe calls); the same suite passes on the reference backend, which says it isolates nothing; the gateway provisions only for the worker holding the session lease at its generation, binds every sandbox to its tenant, and denies and audits cross-tenant use.
audit: MISSING before: the gateway and guest skeletons refused to run; crates/sandbox carried no behavior.
limitations: egress grants refused until M8.6; bearer worker identity (mTLS is deployment config); no jailer; image signing is M8.4; Core tools through the gateway are M8.5.
